name: MailChannels Email API Free
free_limit: Hosted transactional Email API free developer plan: up to 100 recipient sends per day and 3,000 per month, up to 3 sending domains, REST API/SMTP, and 30-day transaction log retention. Monthly allowance resets each billing cycle; unused sends do not roll over.
watch_out: The free Email API is distinct from paid Outbound Filtering and the discontinued legacy Cloudflare Workers sending integration. Each recipient and attempted delivery counts; sending pauses at plan limits without overages. Free plan is described for testing, prototyping and small projects; commercial/production rights and credit-card requirements are not explicitly confirmed. Paid plans start at higher volumes.
